DUTY 1: Performs Career Broadening assignments/duties; working with a multi-functional Senior Logistics Manager providing materiel management guidance/support for all USSOCOM SOF AT&L-managed acquisition and sustainment programs.

This includes the development, review, and validation of materiel management requirements, operational and interim support plans, performance criteria, etc., to ensure accountability, financial reporting, and audit standards are met. Supports/advises SOF AT&L program management offices' regarding materiel management requirements.

Coordinates efforts to ensure appropriate logistics management of SOF AT&L materiel using USSOCOM's Accountable Property System of Record (APSR). Supports SOF AT&L Accountable Inventory Officer on issues affecting all classes of supply stocked, stored, and issued from SOF AT&L designated warehouses.

Assists in development and implementation of policy/guidelines for operation of inventory facilities IAW USSOCOM policies to include Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for warehouse functions of maintenance, returns, frustrated cargo, and inbound/outbound operations.

Assists in the development and documentation of best practices for SOF AT&L property accountability functions to include fielding, field returns, equipment disposition, demilitarization / disposal, and Government Furnished Property (GFP) management.

Supports / enables PEOs' Program Management property accountability processes geared towards achieving auditability.

Assists in the implementation and enforcement of property accountability regulations at the appropriate level and in providing regulatory guidance to PMs on responsibility to maintain property accountability and to provide oversight of property accountable records for USSOCOM.

DUTY 2: In a Career Broadening capacity, ensures weapon systems are acquired, fielded, and sustained using appropriate tailored logistics support strategies resulting in affordable and sustainable weapon systems. Participates with other DoD representatives in the development of functional requirements for emerging systems.

Ensures Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) objectives are developed. recorded, and tracked from user requirements through disposal of assigned acquisition program materiel.

Provides advice on the tailoring of ILS objectives for the acquisition of defense systems / equipment to optimize systems availability/reliability and minimize logistics footprint to reduce operations and total ownership costs. Advises Program Manager (PM) on a comprehensive product support strategy.

Evaluates product support plans and alternatives to ensure optimal use of resources without degrading operational readiness. Advises PM on desired product support outcomes achieved through appropriate product support arrangements. Develops, reviews, and analyzes product support plans and schedules for complex systems.

Provides guidance to PM to develop solicitations for Life Cycle Sustainment Manager (LCSM) selection and makes recommendation of LCSMs based on their ability and proposed cost to accomplish the task.

Provides guidance in the development of logistics-related Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs), logistics section of Statement of Objectives (SOO)/Statement of Work (SOW), and Requests for Information/Proposals (RFI/RFPs). Conducts logistics assessments/evaluations on programs and systems.

Ensures the time phasing of logistics program elements is consistent with systems materiel fielding plans and/or modifications, upgrades. or purchase of various systems.

Ensures criteria is developed and defined to measure and analyze Reliability, Availability. and Maintainability (RAM) data to support full life cycle sustainment of new acquisitions and legacy programs in the PEO's portfolio. Reviews requirements documents.

DUTY 3: Carries out special projects and assignments designed to meet the career broadening intent of the position. Represents the concerns of the organization at meetings and conferences preparing staff studies and various documents to meet special needs.

Develops and presents oral presentations; leading and/or serving on steering committees or completing a project aimed at improving organizational effectiveness. Provides responsive and timely support to customers, actively supports achievement of financial program goals and objectives.

Works to achieve and support quality improvement in all products and services and takes a proactive approach in providing customer assistance. Contributes to timely and viable resolution of issues and problems that are complete, effective, coordinated, and well researched.

Establishes effective professional working relationships with coworkers, or contacts outside the organization contributing to a cooperative working environment and successful accomplishment of the mission.
In order to qualify, you must meet the specialized experience requirements described in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards for General Schedule, Administrative and Management Positions.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization and must have include: 1) A thorough and extensive knowledge of program management strategies and concepts related to Air Force and DoW military structures and missions; 2) In-depth knowledge of DoW logistics policies, procedures, USSOCOM strategies and program tracking processes for program management oversight; 3) Comprehensive knowledge of logistics support requirements, planning, programming, and budgeting for logistics support resources; 4) Comprehensive and expert knowledge of policies, concepts, and procedures affecting logistics, inventory management and procurement functions; 5) Thorough knowledge of USSOCOM and DoW command organizational structures and functions; 6) Mastery of advanced analytical techniques in the determination, programming, and defense of long-range requirements; and 7) Broad knowledge of the relationship of procurement, distribution, budgeting, funding, programming, maintenance, storage, disposal, and other logistical operations is required.

FEDERAL TIME-IN-GRADE (TIG) REQUIREMENT FOR GENERAL SCHEDULE (GS) POSITIONS: Applicants must have served at least 52 weeks at the GS-12 or higher grade (or equivalent in an alternate pay system) within the Federal Civil Service to be considered for referral.

TIG applies if you are in a current GS position or held a GS position within the previous 52 weeks.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Knowledge of DoD and Air Force regulations, principles, and practices pertaining to Logistics support functions.

Knowledge of program planning, funding, and logistics support activities to include determination of fund requirements; supply support systems; integration of supply, transportation, maintenance, and other support activities.

Skill in managing and coordinating complex activities, gathering facts and use of effective, analytical, and evaluative methods to accurately assess information and make sound problem solving decisions.

Skill and ability to work in a multi-functional environment involving interaction with the highest executive and management levels of USSOCOM, DoD, and SOF Service Components. Ability to independently plan, organize, and lead teams to support program activities and execute studies/projects within established financial and/or time constraints.

Ability to communicate effectively with others both orally and in writing, in working out solutions to problems or questions relating to work.

You will serve as a Logistics Management Specialist in the Information Technology Division (SPB16), Operations Management Department (SPB10), Strategic Weapons Facility Pacific (SWFPAC) on Naval Base Kitsap-Bangor, BANGOR, WA.
You will be responsible for tracking fielded IT Equipment and maintains all hardware, network devices, servers and software license information in the IT equipment asset management database.
You will provide reports to management of which assets are scheduled to have their warranty protection expire and need to be placed under an extend warranty or maintenance contract.
You will serve as Hardware/Software Service Contracts Manager for the IT Division using both contract and purchase card vehicles to purchase licensing and support services as requested for customers and functional team leads.
You will serve as SWFPAC Telephone Control Officer (TCO), preparing Local Service Request (LSR) for all new or change of telephone service requests within the Organization.
You will provide a complete range of administrative services to support the agencies facilities.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower pay band, NH-01 (GS-04 Equivalent), in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector: 1. Attention to Detail- Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail. 2.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services. 3.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately. 4.

You will assist with receipt and response to all technical publication deficiency reports (TPDRs) submitted to the Fleet Support Team (FST) or Integrated Program Team, providing timely and effective resolution to fleet inquiries.
You will evaluate fleet requirements by discussing fleet concerns, fleet TPDRs, messages, and publication problems highlighted in Fleet Publication Review Conferences by end users.
You will evaluate current and proposed technical modifications (i.e. via Engineering Change Proposals and Technical Directives) to aircraft weapon systems.
You will plan and execute integration and incorporation of the above requirements throughout all affected maintenance and operational publications.
You will be required to prepare and submit Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) for technical data packages for modification programs, to include scheduling information, milestone initiation, and delivery dates.
You will review, upon receipt of CORL deliverables, the data and provide recommendations of acceptance or rejection in accordance with contact requirements to the program office.
You will participate in and support Technical Manual/Technical Data planning and sustainment conferences as directed by the supported program office(s).
You will use strong analytical and communication skills to interpret engineering and logistics data and translate it into clear, concise written content.
You will utilize a high degree of computer literacy including proficiency with advanced word processing, desktop publishing, or graphics software.
You will display creativity and experienced judgement in extending traditional techniques and seek direction and approval in order to employ new procedure to resolve complex maintenance and design problems.
You will perform most technical tasks independently and will work on more sophisticated or complex tasks with a Logistics Manager or Subject Matter Expert.
For the GS-11 Position: Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the (GS-09) grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: 1) Inspecting and maintaining interactive electronic technical documentation by utilizing advanced publishing software (e.g.

Arbortext, Adobe InDesign, XML, EAGLE, and Interleaf) to perform rigorous quality assurance reviews and accurately incorporate technical publication deficiency reports, engineering change feedback, interim updates, and redline markups; 2) Incorporating technical data changes into command/company manuals; 3) Assisting with the creation of technical changes to aircraft weapon systems while also planning and executing integration and incorporation of these requirements throughout all affected maintenance and operation publications; 4) Providing milestones and delivery dates regarding development of technical documents for specific weapon systems and subsystems; and 5) Assisting with scheduling information and other pertinent data necessary for inclusion of technical data requirements in logistics support planning documents.

For the GS-09 Position: Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the (GS-07) grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following 1) Demonstrating a thorough understanding of technical manual and publication authoring software and tools (e.g., Arbortext, EAGLE Publishing Systems, Quicksilver, etc.); 2) Developing, authoring, and/or managing technical manuals and publications for an assigned aircraft platform; and 3) Communicating, both orally and in writing, complex technical data requirements in order to convey data issues and restrictions for assigned program(s), negotiating changes in data requirements, evaluating contractor inputs, and making recommendations to decision authority, engineers, logisticians, private contractors, vendors, and personnel at all levels of maintenance management.

As a General Supply Specialist, GS-2001-09, you will: Perform analysis on a wide range of technical squadron functions by analyzing historical and current data and identifying deficiencies or potential problems during surveillances or staff assistance visits.

Evaluate unexpected fluctuations or trends in statistics, resolves discrepancies, and makes recommendations for change when problems are identified that adversely affect operations. Perform analysis on current or potential problems identified by flight management.

Compare supply performance and maintenance interface data with prescribed standards to identify the effectiveness of supply support. Perform in-depth research and special analyses and makes appropriate recommendations for improvement. Facilitate corrective measures when specific actions are required by other elements.

Serve as the point of contact for all customer problems unresolved at flight level. Utilizes computer software programs, spreadsheets, databases and graphics to collect, organize, analyze, display, and/or brief management information to customers and/or squadron management staff.

Monitor inventory losses by analyses of inventory discrepancies, adjustments, and trends to ensure the integrity of the base resources management system. Receive incoming shipment discrepancy reports and evaluates and performs analyses on incoming and outgoing reports to ensure the effectiveness of the Supply Discrepancy Report (SDR) program.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience that equipped you with the particular competencies to successfully perform the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled.

Creditable specialized experience includes: Experience with retail supply and inventory management functions, material coordination, awaiting parts procedures, supporting repair programs and local purchase/local manufacturer processes.

Experience with performing tailored customer support functions relating to consumable and/or exchangeable parts required for depot maintenance and repair activities. Experience with Order Fulfillment (including distribution system and ordering applications).

Education must be from a college or university accredited by an organization approved by the U.S. Department of Education. See http://ope.ed.gov/accreditation/Search.aspx. If using education to meet basic qualifications, YOU MUST SUBMIT A TRANSCRIPT as supplemental documentation.

Combination: Combinations of successfully completed post-high school education and experience may be used to meet total qualification requirements for grade level GS-09, and may be computed by first determining the applicant's total qualifying experience as a percentage of the experience required for the grade level; then determining the applicant's education as a percentage of the education required for the grade level; and then adding the two percentages.

The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify an applicant for that grade level. Only graduate education in excess of the amount required for the next lower grade level may be used to qualify applicants for positions at grade GS-09.

Als Lernende:r bei IKEA Schweiz bist du nicht allein unterwegs - du bist Teil einer grossen Lernenden-Community. Gemeinsam erlebt ihr, wie spannend und abwechslungsreich es ist, in einem internationalen Unternehmen zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und euch weiterzuentwickeln. Denn während deiner Lehre zeigen wir dir Schritt für Schritt alles, was du brauchst, um nach der Ausbildung sicher im Berufsleben zu stehen und deine eigenen Ziele zu erreichen.
In der Logistik arbeitest du hinter den Kulissen und bist trotzdem mitten im IKEA Erlebnis. Du sorgst mit deinem Team dafür, dass unsere Produkte zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind und unsere Regale mit einwandfreier Ware gefüllt sind. So trägst du direkt dazu bei, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden das finden, was sie suchen und ein angenehmes Einkaufserlebnis haben.
Du musst noch nicht alles können! Wichtig ist, dass du neugierig bist, gerne lernst und Lust hast, dich bei IKEA einzubringen.
Damit du gut zu uns passt, bringst du idealerweise Folgendes mit:
· Du findest spannend, was hinter den Kulissen passiert und möchtest sehen, wie Logistik in echt funktioniert - von der Lieferung im Lager bis ins Regal im Einrichtungshaus.
· Du bist gerne in Bewegung, packst mit an und fühlst dich wohl in einem Umfeld, in dem es auch mal schnell gehen kann.
· Du arbeitest gerne im Team, zum Beispiel bei Gruppenarbeiten in der Schule oder in einem Verein, kannst Aufgaben aber auch selbständig erledigen.
· Du bist offen, respektvoll und kommunizierst ehrlich - auch mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen - und trägst zu einer positiven Stimmung im Team bei.
· Du kannst dir vorstellen, in Früh- oder Spätschichten sowie auch mal am Samstag zu arbeiten, gehst sicher mit Computer oder Tablet um, sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und verstehst schon ein bisschen Englisch.
**Du bist verantwortlich für**
· Du lernst, wie du zusammen mit deinem Team im Hintergrund dafür sorgst, dass unser IKEA Einrichtungshaus und das Lager immer gut gefüllt sind - damit unsere Kundinnen und Kunden das finden, was sie suchen.
· Du übst, wie du LKWs auslädst und die Ware an den richtigen Ort bringst - ins Lager oder direkt auf die Verkaufsfläche, damit alles schnell verfügbar ist.
· Du arbeitest mit unseren Computer-Systemen: Du lernst, Bestände zu kontrollieren und zu erfassen, damit wir wissen, wie viel von welchem Produkt noch da ist.
· Du merkst, wie wichtig Teamwork mit anderen Abteilungen ist - zum Beispiel mit dem Verkauf oder dem Kundendienst - damit der Weg vom Warenankauf bis zum Einkaufserlebnis für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden gut funktioniert.
· Du lernst, sorgfältig und sicher zu arbeiten: Du achtest auf Ordnung, hältst dich an Sicherheitsregeln und hilfst mit, Menschen, Produkte und Arbeitsmittel zu schützen.
Bitte reiche deine Bewerbung online ein. Bewerbungen per E-Mail oder Post können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen.

s.h: Füge die folgende Dateien deinem Profil hinzu
s.t:
· deinen Lebenslauf bzw. ein Dokument mit mehr Infos über dich\* - damit wir sehen, wer du bist, was dir wichtig ist und was dich besonders macht.
· die Zeugnisse der letzten zwei Schuljahre - so sehen wir, ob du für eine EBA oder EFZ (mit oder ohne BM) bereit bist. Wir wollen offen und ehrlich sein: Unentschuldigte Absenzen verunsichern uns, ob du genug Motivation für die doch ziemlich anstrengende Berufsschule mitbringst. Falls du Absenzen hast, würde uns eine kurze Erklärung in deiner Bewerbung helfen, damit wir deine Situation besser verstehen und deine Motivation richtig einschätzen können.
· freiwillige Beilagen wie z.B. Schnupperberichte oder persönliche Arbeiten/Projekte, auf die du stolz bist

Ein Motivationsschreiben ist bei uns nicht obligatorisch. Wir suchen Menschen, die zu uns passen und motiviert sind, ihre Lehre bei IKEA zu machen. Deshalb laden wir Bewerbende, die in der engeren Wahl sind, zu einem Nachmittag im IKEA-Einrichtungshaus ein, um uns kennenzulernen und damit du einen ersten Einblick erhältst, wie eine Lehre bei IKEA abläuft. So fällt uns allen die Entscheidung danach leichter, ob es gut passt - dir und uns.
Der Kennenlern-Tag findet am 17.09.2026 von 09:00 - 17:00 Uhr im Einrichtungshaus Spreitenbach statt.
Mehr Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess sowie unsere wichtigsten Bewerbungstipps findest du auf unserer Internetseite: www.ikea.ch/berufsbildung
Ach ja, schau mal, als Lernende/r bei IKEA Schweiz gibt es nichts als Vorteile!
· IKEA übernimmt alle obligatorischen Kosten deiner Lehre und du bekommst für diese Zeit sogar einen Laptop zur Verfügung gestellt.
· Du bist Teil einer grossen Lernenden-Community mit über 100 Lernenden in der ganzen Schweiz.
· Gute Noten, gute Belohnung: Bei guten Schulnoten wartet ein Semestergeschenk auf dich.
· Du hast fixe Lernstunden im Betrieb, damit du deine Aufgaben erledigen kannst - und trotzdem genug Zeit für Freunde & Hobbys hast.
· Du lernst nicht nur eine Ecke kennen: Während der Lehre wechselst du verschiedene Abteilungen in deinem Fachbereich.
· Eine Berufsbildnerin oder ein Berufsbildner ist an deiner Seite, gibt dir Feedback und unterstützt dich auf deinem Weg.
· Lust auf ein Mini-Ausland bei IKEA? Wenn du möchtest, kannst du während der Lehre einen kurzen Austausch in einem anderen Einrichtungshaus machen - und nach der Lehre stehen dir natürlich viele internationale Möglichkeiten offen.
· Und: Hast du unseren TikTok-Kanal schon entdeckt? Unsere Lernenden können dort freiwillig mitmachen und Einblicke hinter die Kulissen geben.

Fondée en 1927, SICPA est une entreprise technologique privée suisse qui soutient la bonne gouvernance et la prospérité à long terme des nations.
SICPA établit *le pouls de la souveraineté*, permettant aux gouvernements de protéger leurs citoyens, leurs actifs souverains et leurs économies. Reconnue principalement pour la sécurisation de la majorité des billets de banque dans le monde, SICPA opère sur cinq continents.

Aujourd-hui, notre plateforme pour la souveraineté offre des solutions intégrées garantissant la mobilisation des recettes, les ressources naturelles, la santé, la protection des marques ainsi que la souveraineté numérique et les services publics sécurisés.

* Coordination des flux de commandes de vente, réalisation des transactions depuis les devis jusqu-aux livraisons, y compris la facturation et les dédouanements, maintenance des données principales
* Coordination du processus d-expédition incluant la documentation d-expédition et le suivi, communication du statut et des retards, tenue des dossiers import-export conformément aux réglementations et politiques
* Enregistrement et validation des expéditions via les organismes de certification/vérification lorsque requis

**Logistics Specialist (Global Clinical Distribution)**

**Background:**
The Clinical Distribution organisation's objective is to cost-effectively ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time every time, such that no patient will go without treatment and no clinical trial will be delayed.

The Logistics Specialist is a key member of the Network \& Capability chapter, which is jointly accountable for all elements of clinical supply chain distribution for the global Roche/Genentech portfolio of \>500 studies.

The global Network \& Capability chapter is responsible for the logistic framework and setup to enable optimized and reliable clinical distribution for all studies (more than 100k shipments yearly across \>130 countries), through effective use of industry- leading clinical distribution strategies (e.g. direct 2 patients), processes and systems.
The Logistics Specialist role executes all shipments and ensures they are processed without interruptions and in line with country requirements. The Logistics Specialist partners closely with the internal and external logistics partners and the broader distribution community (incl. all Chapters), IT and the Roche network to enable the portfolio and pipeline delivery.

* Responsible to manage all relevant documents/licenses considering country specific requirements
* Monitor shipments to ensure on-time delivery to proactively address potential challenges and interruptions
* Responsible for managing and keeping country specific requirements and keeping them up to date
* Acts as the main contact for stakeholders and partners on all shipping and logistics related questions and activities
* Closely collaborates with the various site logistics teams, incl. warehouse (KAU and SSF), transportation and customs management
* Involvement in projects and initiatives after relevant time spent in the role

* Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience
* GDP (Good Distribution Practice) experience is strictly required (GMP is a plus)
* ERP Systems: SAP knowledge is nice-to-have, but experience with alternative domain-specific ERP/Logistics tools is accepted
* Office Applications: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace is mandatory
* German \& English: Business-fluent (proficient with industry-specific vocabulary).

* Mindset \& Drive: Strong sense of urgency, proactive mindset, and ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
* System Affinity: High affinity for IT systems/ERP, with hands-on experience in SAP considered a strong plus

* Varied job profile

Our client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Inventory & Logistics Specialist to oversee end-to-end supply chain and inventory operations.

This full-time remote role combines freight management, Amazon FBA coordination, inventory forecasting, and reverse logistics to ensure smooth operations across all sales channels.

If you are experienced in e-commerce logistics, Amazon fulfillment, and supply chain optimization, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, wed love to hear from you.

The company is a premium pet brand known for its high-quality, durable bulky pet products and accessories. Built for both professionals and devoted pet owners, the brands products are designed with attention to detail, functionality, and longevity. The brand is committed to creating elevated, practical experiences for pets and their people—and is looking for an Inventory & Logistics Specialist to help scale that mission by ensuring seamless product flow from factory to customer.

Freight & Supply Chain Management
Manage end-to-end order placement with factories and track order progress through to completion.
Request, negotiate, and select the best quotes from freight forwarders, determining the optimal type of sea freight for each specific situation.
Design ideal loading configurations for shipping containers based on product dimensions to maximize space and reduce shipping costs.
Oversee the loading process through active communication with factories and freight partners.
Track all global shipments, proactively flagging and mitigating any potential delays.
Amazon FBA & E-commerce Operations
Create and manage Amazon Shipments, utilizing software solutions (e.g., 9Yards and similar simulation tools) to run multiple simulations and target the most cost-effective Amazon warehouses.
Oversee the receiving of units at both Amazon fulfillment centers and partner 3PL warehouses.
Perform thorough reconciliation for all inbound shipments to ensure accurate stock levels and file claims for missing units when necessary.
Coordinate Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) orders for Last Mile transport from our 3PL to customers for non-Amazon (DTC/B2B) orders.
Inventory Forecasting & Management
Continuously monitor inventory levels across all sales channels to prevent overstocking or Out-of-Stock (OOS) situations.
Forecast inventory movements and project OOS dates at the SKU level to accurately plan factory order quantities.
Reverse Logistics & Returns Management
Create and manage Amazon removal orders for customer returns.
Arrange transport from Amazon to 3PL/processing facilities.
Oversee the de-kitting, inspection, and sorting of damaged units into tiers for parts harvesting or resale.

Container Shipments: ~8 per month.
LTL Orders (Last Mile): ~10 per week.
Factory Orders: ~6 per year.

Amazon FBA & E-commerce Systems: Deep expertise with Amazon Seller Central, FBA placement optimization, inbound reconciliation, and removal/disposal orders.
Forecasting & Inventory Management: Hands-on experience with IMS tools (SoStocked, RestockPro, Cin7, Skubana), advanced Excel or Google Sheets for SKU-level forecasting and run-rate models.
Logistics, Freight & 3PL Integration: Familiarity with container load planning software (EasyCargo, CubeMaster), freight platforms (Flexport, Freightos), warehouse management systems (ShipStation, ShipHero), and reverse logistics workflows.
Core Competencies
3+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon inventory management.
Proven ability to manage complex shipments and multi-stage fulfillment workflows across international markets.
Strong understanding of Amazon FBA processes and multi-channel e-commerce operations.
Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to build and interpret detailed SKU-level forecasting and inventory models.
Practical experience coordinating international freight, container shipments, and 3PL operations in a multi-channel environment.
Strong problem-solving skills and high attention to detail.
Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
Alignment with the companys premium brand standards and operational excellence mindset.

Play a critical role in ensuring smooth operations for a high-ticket pet brand on Amazon.
Own inventory planning, logistics, and fulfillment workflows.
Work remotely from anywhere.

**Das bringst du mit**
Wir suchen junge Menschen mit Begeisterung, Freude und Motivation, die etwas bewegen wollen. Folgende Punkte solltest du erfüllen:

* Das Arbeiten im Team bereitet dir Freude.

* Du bist zuverlässig, ehrlich und verschwiegen.
* Die obligatorische Schulpflicht hast du abgeschlossen.
* Bei Lehrbeginn verfügst du über das Sprachniveau B2 in Deutsch.

About Nivoda 🚀
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry.

As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules.

This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end.

Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution.
It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one.
What will you be doing? 😎
Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform
Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product
Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework
Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found
Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately
Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission
Monitor the US import bond and keep it compliant, since this underpins business continuity for our largest lane
Partnering with our manufacturers (starting with India) to ensure their export documentation and processes support compliant, duty-efficient shipping
Identifying and acting on duty-saving opportunities through relevant free trade agreements (e.g. India-UK, EU-UK, EU-India, UAE-India)
Building out trade compliance processes as our jewellery business scales into new duty-liable markets, and escalating complex classification or legal interpretation questions to Legal & Compliance
What do we need from you? 💪
Proven experience in global trade compliance or customs operations, with a track record on US, UK, EU import/export specifically
Extensive US import-export experience is required.
Direct experience managing customs broker relationships and shipment documentation at volume
Experience filing duty drawback or tariff reclaim claims
Comfortable working as an individual contributor with real autonomy
Detail-oriented and process-minded: you'll be establishing how this works at Nivoda, not just following an existing playbook
Based in the EU or UK, with the flexibility to work across time zones as we scale globally
Strong stakeholder management skills, coordinating external brokers/carriers/manufacturers and internal Legal, Fulfilment, and Ops teams
A commercial mindset, you connect compliance work back to cost savings and business impact

Experience with free trade agreements and preferential duty schemes (e.g. India–UK, EU–UK, EU–India, UAE–India)
Experience in jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, or other high-value/luxury goods logistics
Experience with Indian export processes
Background in a fast-scaling, international e-commerce or marketplace business

As a Shipping Specialist, you will be responsible for the expedient movement of designated items needed to support production, test, and launch operations. As a Shipping Specialist, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient and timely delivery of our products to internal and external customers.

Your primary responsibilities will include preparing and processing shipments, coordinating logistics, packaging, exception management, risk mitigation and maintaining and complying with global trade regulations.

Process outbound material through ERP system, partnering with appropriate departments to ensure quality and quantity of material is delivered to vendors, staged for shipping and or transferred between SpaceX locations
Properly package and manifest parcel, LTL, and large freight as required to ensure product integrity throughout the transportation cycle to intended destination
Manifest consignments with information provided by requestor and schedule movements accordingly based on delivery demand (FedEx, UPS, DHL, 3PL vendors, expedite courier services, etc.), ensuring that each package has the correct information and configuration to guarantee intended delivery conditions
Coordinate with carriers and freight forwarders to schedule pick-up and delivery of shipments
Prepare shipping labels, packing slips, and other necessary documents for each shipment
Verify the accuracy of shipping information, including addresses, product quantities, and delivery instructions
Inspect and package products for shipment, ensuring proper packaging and labeling
Determine the most cost-effective and efficient shipping methods for each order
Track and monitor shipments to ensure on-time delivery and resolve any issues or delays and accurately update required tracking systems (spreadsheets, modules, external data sources)
